response.text: {"name":"Under the Ridge","idea":"Apartmaji Pod Voglom are, as their name says, the house under Vogel at the quiet western end of Lake Bohinj, so the page reads like the valley itself: the mountain ridge on top, the house beneath it, and a short 300 m walk down to the water.","palette":[{"role":"band","hex":"#12403f"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#e6f0ee"},{"role":"background","hex":"#eef4f3"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#ffffff"},{"role":"text","hex":"#16262a"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#4a5f62"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#b23f28"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#f6f8f7"},{"role":"accent","hex":"#8cc2ba"},{"role":"border","hex":"#c6d6d4"}],"pairing":"bitter-karla","typeCharacter":"Bitter is a sturdy, warm slab serif with the feel of a carved wooden house sign.
